dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't understand what you're talking about...

dialogues.speaker: Carranza
dialogues.text: Excellent. I don't want you to understand, because if you did, you would become a rival.

dialogues.speaker: Carranza
dialogues.text: But if you really are in desperate need of someone to talk to, we could discuss something else entirely. Something that will not harm anyone's interests. Math, for example...
